name: greytHR
description_en:
greytHR is a cloud HR and payroll platform combining employee records, onboarding and exit, leave, self-service and configurable workflows. The reviewed Indian pricing page separates Essential, Growth and Premium; advanced attendance is a Growth capability, while several other functions are add-ons.

A useful evaluation follows an employee’s attendance exception through manager review and month-end processing, then checks the result against payroll. This draft distinguishes documented configuration options from live execution and uses the India price schedule without extrapolating it to other countries.
description_zh:
greytHR 是云端 HR 与工资平台，组合员工档案、入离职、休假、自助及可配置流程。所读印度价格页区分 Essential、Growth、Premium；高级考勤属于 Growth 能力，其他若干功能另收附加费。

评估可跟踪一次员工考勤异常，经经理审核和月末处理后核对工资结果。本稿区分文档中的配置选项和实际执行，并仅使用印度价目，不扩展为其他国家的价格。

core_features.explanation_en: HR pages describe records, onboarding, confirmation, exit, letters, checklists and Excel import.
core_features.explanation_zh: HR 页面描述档案、入职、转正、离职、信函、清单及 Excel 导入。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure shifts and computation rules, alert employees about exceptions and route regularization to managers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可配置班次及计算规则，提醒员工异常并由经理审核考勤补正。

core_features.explanation_en: Attendance Permissions handles time away shorter than a half-day, with configurable policy and approval or rejection.
core_features.explanation_zh: Attendance Permissions 管理不足半天的离岗，可配置政策并批准或拒绝申请。

pricing.summary_en: India: Essential ₹2,495/month incl. 50, ₹45/additional employee; Growth ₹4,495 incl. 50, ₹85/additional; Premium quote. Add-ons and annual-credit terms matter.
pricing.summary_zh: 印度：Essential 每月 2,495 卢比含 50 人，超额每人 45；Growth 为 4,495 含 50 人，超额每人 85；Premium 询价。需考虑附加项和年度余额条款。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Organize the lifecycle before automating it
sections.title_zh: 先梳理生命周期再自动化
sections.en: greytHR’s HR product page describes employee data, letters, documents, assets, checklists and workflows from onboarding and confirmation through exit. Self-service provides access to payslips, policies, forms and tax information; communications include notices and targeted messages. An illustrative rollout could import a small employee set, verify reporting lines and document permissions, then run a confirmation checklist. The presence of an Excel import feature does not prove arbitrary spreadsheets will reconcile correctly. Establish identifiers and field owners before moving records, and inspect exports before retiring the old source.
sections.zh: greytHR HR 产品页描述从入职、转正到离职的员工数据、信函、文档、资产、清单和流程。自助入口提供工资单、政策、表单及税务资料，也有通知和定向消息。上线示例可以先导入少量员工，核对汇报关系和文档权限，再执行转正确认清单。具备 Excel 导入不代表任意表格均能正确对齐。迁移前需确定编号和字段维护人，停用旧来源前应检查导出。

sections.title_en: Trace one exception through month end
sections.en: The attendance page documents multiple capture channels, shifts and rotation, work-hour computation, lateness and absence rules, daily processing and month-end finalization. Employees can receive exception alerts and submit regularization for manager approval. Consider a missed check-out: compare the raw event, proposed correction, approved attendance and month-end payroll input. Short absence permissions are separate from half- or full-day leave. Device compatibility, approval history, re-opening finalized periods and payroll recalculation were not tested, so those should be explicit acceptance cases rather than assumed behavior.
sections.zh: 考勤页列出多种采集渠道、轮班、工时计算、迟到缺勤规则、每日处理及月末确认。员工收到异常提醒后可提交补正，由经理审批。例如下班漏卡，应核对原始事件、拟议更正、批准后的考勤和月末工资输入。短时离岗与半天或整天休假不同。本研究未测试设备兼容、审批历史、重新打开已确认期间和工资重算，这些应列为明确验收场景。

sections.title_en: Attendance and APIs change the purchase
sections.title_zh: 考勤与 API 会影响采购范围
sections.en: The Indian price page says every plan includes payroll, leave and employee self-service. Essential includes basic core HR; Growth adds advanced attendance, shifts, overtime, permissions and geofencing. SSO and API access are add-ons on the lower plans; Premium includes SSO, API and multi-company support. Performance, timesheets and expenses have their own package conditions. Premium’s “all modules” label is qualified by the same page: GPS Live Tracking, Recruit and Alumni Portal still appear as add-ons. Do not treat mobile access, basic geofencing and paid live GPS tracking as identical entitlements.
sections.zh: 印度价格页称每个套餐均包含工资、休假和员工自助。Essential 包含基础 HR，Growth 增加高级考勤、班次、加班、短时离岗和地理围栏。低档套餐的 SSO 和 API 另收费，Premium 包含 SSO、API 和多公司支持。绩效、工时表及费用各有套餐条件。Premium 的“全部模块”仍有同页限定：GPS 实时追踪、Recruit、Alumni Portal 继续列为附加项。移动访问、基础围栏和收费实时 GPS 跟踪不能视为同一权益。

sections.title_en: Compute the base plus additional employees
sections.title_zh: 按基础费加超额人数计算
sections.en: Essential is ₹2,495 per month including 50 employees, plus ₹45 for each employee above 50. Growth is ₹4,495 including 50, plus ₹85 above 50; Premium is custom quoted. For 60 employees, the published base formula gives ₹2,945 or ₹5,345 per month before add-ons and any applicable taxes or other quoted charges. This is arithmetic from the schedule, not a purchased quote. Listed add-ons include timesheets ₹35 per user monthly, expenses ₹35, performance ₹35–₹45, live GPS ₹140, Recruit ₹2,500 per recruiter and Alumni Portal ₹20 per user; package eligibility matters. A seven-day trial becomes paid only after choosing a plan. The FAQ says annual-plan remaining credit is not refunded on discontinuation despite no cancellation fee or lock-in.
sections.zh: Essential 每月 2,495 卢比含 50 人，超过部分每人 45 卢比；Growth 每月 4,495 卢比含 50 人，超额每人 85 卢比；Premium 定制报价。按公布基础公式，60 人分别为每月 2,945 或 5,345 卢比，尚未加附加产品及适用税费或其他报价费用。这是价目计算，并非购买报价。列出的月度附加项包括工时表每用户 35 卢比、费用 35、绩效 35–45、实时 GPS 140、Recruit 每招聘人员 2,500、Alumni Portal 每用户 20，均有套餐适用条件。七天试用后需选套餐才继续付费。FAQ 虽称无取消费或锁定期，但年度订阅中途停用时剩余余额不退。

sections.title_en: Test the local rules and the exit path
sections.title_zh: 测试本地规则及退出路径
sections.en: greytHR is relevant to teams wanting linked HR, leave and payroll with a configurable attendance layer. A buyer needing extensive integrations should include API and SSO costs from the start. Prepare pay groups, shifts, leave balances, attendance exceptions and approvers; run a parallel period including a correction and rejected permission request. Compliance and security statements are vendor claims, not an audit or a guarantee about any particular employer. Exact tax coverage, signed terms, hosting region, complete export and integration retries remain unverified. The reviewed pages describe cloud software and do not establish an open-source or self-hosted edition.
sections.zh: 需要联动 HR、休假和工资并配置考勤规则的团队可以评估 greytHR。依赖大量集成的买家，应从一开始计入 API 和 SSO 成本。需准备工资组、班次、休假余额、考勤异常及审批人，并行测试一期，包含一次更正和拒批离岗申请。合规及安全说法属于供应商声明，未经审计，也不保证特定雇主合规。具体税务覆盖、签署条款、托管区域、完整导出和集成重试均未核实。所读页面描述云软件，未确立开源或自托管版本。
